adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sync is enabled it always POSTs to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` with a hardcoded `URLSearchParams` body containing only `calcomUserId` and `appSlug` (see the inline comment “Customize the payload…”). Because this logic lives in a shared utility used across integrations, any customization requires editing this shared library file rather than being provided via configuration or per-consumer override, matching the finding.
